entries.description: Nightly Combo A options dataset (Mid >= $1.00, OI >= 500, Delta 0.22–0.48, DTE 10–45, rv_iv_ratio), 10-minute intraday liquidity snapshots, and 3-day excursion outcome surfaces for AI agents. Free 3-contract preview on /mcp; full 40–50 contract daily dataset and intraday tools on /pro ($299/yr or $29/mo founding price, 7-day free trial). Your agent builds the trade plan with you. Educational only. Not investment advice.
